raw.buffDescription:
Each Phase has a cumulative [k=glossary/reversal][bc22c6]Reversal[-][/k] trigger. When a Reversal triggers, Winter Soldier gains an Energize.

•Phase 1: [eb1212]You're The Punching Bag Now.[-] New Reversal trigger: [bc22c6]Light [k=glossary/combo_enders][bc22c6]Combo-Enders[-][/k][-].
•Phase 2: At 75% Health, new Reversal trigger: [bc22c6]Medium [k=glossary/combo_enders][bc22c6]Combo-Enders[-][/k][-].
•Phase 3: At 40%, new Reversal trigger: [bc22c6]Striking a Stunned Winter Soldier with a Basic Attack[-].
•Phase 4: At 1%, new Reversal trigger: [bc22c6]Hitting Winter Soldier’s Block[-]. Additionally, the Attacker must [52aa17]Choose Peace[-] 3 times to remove [k=glossary/cross_fight_ability_winter_soldier]Cross-Fight[/k] Indestructible Passives and then defeat Winter Soldier with a Special 2.

Each Phase transition gives Winter Soldier [k=glossary/intimidate]Intimidate[/k] and [k=glossary/indestructible]Indestructible[/k] Passives for 5 seconds, removes all his Wounded and Energizes, and resets his Power and all [f8c11b]Hostility Charges[-].
